title: CrowdGPT x HiveMind weekend, 14-15 November 2026: what is available

model.note: Crowd-v1 is not a MoE and is not split into parts; HiveMind does not run a sparse-MoE upcycle of it.

available.action: Train the shared dense Crowd-v1 with CrowdGPT's official client and submit rounds to CrowdGPT's server.
safety: weights are safetensors; the client runs no code from the server
updates only if signed by the maintainer; --no-update pins the version

available.action: Call hivemind/crowd-v1 through the HiveMind gateway (OpenAI-compatible chat completions).
available.notes: Honour Retry-After on HTTP 429 and back off exponentially; producers see the prompts they serve, so send only public, non-sensitive text.

available.action: Serve a model with the HiveMind producer agent.
available.network: outbound HTTPS only, no listening port

available.requires: an evaluator id and key issued by CrowdGPT (Vxtzq)
safety: every downloaded file is checked against its SHA-256
works only while --governor-state reports the GPU idle

available.action: Test hivemind/crowd-v1 in an IDE (Continue, Cline, Aider) and report wrong or strange answers in the discussion thread.

not_available: HiveMind's own OpenTrainer weight-sharing path: the OpenTrainer agent reports numbers only, recorded as CLIENT_REPORTED_UNVERIFIED (use CrowdGPT's client to train instead).
Sign-up welcome credit (the gateway's starter grant is 0).

hardware.tesla_t4: GCP Spot VM, scheduled 14:00-22:00 Europe/Paris on 14 and 15 November; keeps >= 4300 MiB free VRAM; contributing to CrowdGPT with the official client since 2026-11-14 14:48 UTC
